title: Ablation Method Sensitivity Index: Quantifying How Much Benchmark Results Depend on Corruption Strategy

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If circuit conclusions flip depending on ablation choice, published safety claims about which components matter may be unreliable. A sensitivity index gives reviewers a single number to assess result robustness. Clear chain from measurement tool to improved reliability of safety claims.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: GPT-2-Small on TransformerLens with the IOI task. Four corruption strategies are all standard and well-documented. Running four variants of the same experiment is repetitive but not complex. Beginners can implement each strategy by following existing tutorials.

narrow_scope.reasoning: One model, one task, four ablation strategies, one metric (variance-based sensitivity index). Clear deliverable as a ranked table and a single sensitivity number. Three published circuits provide validation targets. Fits comfortably in 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
